title: Response-free root-uptake state-sufficiency discriminator
scientific_question: Can existing Layer-ROM storage states, or storage plus the conservation-derived geometric first water-content moment, uniquely determine drought-only Feddes root uptake when admissible within-layer hydraulic structure varies?

synthetic_feddes_contract.purpose: Structural identifiability only; these are not crop/application calibration values.
synthetic_feddes_contract.uptake_normalization: Report actual uptake as fraction of potential transpiration; absolute T_p cancels.

root_distributions.weights: Exact increments of cumulative F over each fine cell.

fine_grid.purpose: Synthetic evaluation grid only; no Richards solve.

sublayer_profile_family.P1_PLUS: mean + amplitude*x with x centered/scaled to [-1,1] and discrete mean removed
sublayer_profile_family.P1_MINUS: mean - amplitude*x with discrete mean removed
sublayer_profile_family.P2_PLUS: mean + amplitude*P2(x), P2=(3x^2-1)/2 with discrete mean removed
sublayer_profile_family.P2_MINUS: mean - amplitude*P2(x) with discrete mean removed
sublayer_profile_family.construction: Every pattern exactly preserves each retained layer's integrated storage on the frozen fine grid.
sublayer_profile_family.S_plus_M_pair: P2_PLUS and P2_MINUS are even about each retained-layer center and therefore preserve the same centered geometric first water-content moment as each other and P0 on the symmetric fine grid.

exact_uptake.fine_formula: U=sum_n Delta f_n * alpha(h_n), where U is actual/potential transpiration fraction.
exact_uptake.layer_formula: Equivalent sum over retained layers; no coarse approximation is used for the oracle.

diagnostics.storage_only_ambiguity: Within each material/partition/coarse-state/amplitude/root-profile/demand-class equivalence set, max(U)-min(U) across P0/P1+/P1-/P2+/P2-.
diagnostics.S_plus_M_ambiguity: Absolute U(P2_PLUS)-U(P2_MINUS), after verifying equal retained S and M.
diagnostics.mean_storage_feedback_approximation: Also report the error of the simplest existing-state approximation U_bar=sum_I Delta F_I*alpha(h(theta_bar_I)); this is a diagnostic only and is not selected as an accepted ET closure.
diagnostics.partition_summary: Report max and median ambiguity/errors separately by material and partition; no rank becomes a new partition authority.

hypotheses.H_STORAGE_NOT_EXACTLY_SUFFICIENT: At least one frozen equivalence set has storage-only uptake ambiguity > 1e-10 while all matched-storage checks pass.
hypotheses.H_S_PLUS_M_NOT_EXACTLY_SUFFICIENT: At least one P2_PLUS/P2_MINUS pair has uptake ambiguity > 1e-10 while both retained storage and centered first moment match <= frozen tolerances.
hypotheses.H_MEAN_STORAGE_FEEDBACK_NOT_EXACT: At least one case has nonzero exact-vs-mean-storage uptake-fraction error > 1e-10.

decision_logic.scientific_meaning: Exact state identifiability only. No ambiguity magnitude is an application tolerance.

stop_rules: No crop/application interpretation of the synthetic Se-anchored Feddes thresholds.
No state, partition or uptake closure is selected from ambiguity magnitude.
